subject.title: Models: fully dynamic model discovery (OpenRouter + beyond)

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a provider-plugin dynamic-catalog seam, and if so should OpenRouter discovery be the first provider implementation with catalog visibility kept separate from model authorization?
rationale: The remaining work changes provider/plugin API shape, cache identity, picker UX, and safety semantics; source evidence supports several viable boundaries but cannot select the permanent contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt a provider-owned catalog seam
options.body: Define a generic optional provider discovery contract with credential-scoped caching and implement OpenRouter through that seam while preserving configured model authorization.

options.title: Keep discovery provider-specific
options.body: Implement a narrow OpenRouter plugin path first and defer any shared catalog API until a second provider proves the common abstraction.

options.title: Retain static catalogs
options.body: Keep current static catalog behavior and document configured custom-model workflows rather than adding live discovery.

recommendation.title: Adopt a provider-owned catalog seam
recommendation.body: Define a generic optional provider discovery contract with credential-scoped caching and implement OpenRouter through that seam while preserving configured model authorization.

likelyOwner.reason: The assignee's issue design defines the open policy choices and is the strongest available routing signal.
